$Comment: What a participant sees the instant the Scarak Brood Queen falls: the hive is quiet, and
beneath it their own share of the fight. The queen's binding row points its Defeated beat here
(Feedback.Defeated), so the words belong to this fight alone.
The moment fires once per participant the fight credited and carries 'share' (that reader's
credited share of the fight as whole percent points, the top contributor reading 100, which is
what their loot rolls were scaled by) and 'seconds' (how long she stood). The second line is
the library's own share line, which ships translated in every language the library does, and
it is the answer to why each player got what they got: the fight pays its table per share, and
the rewards land as rows under this headline on the in-page toast. Gold Reward tone and the
game's own discovery sting, because a world boss falling is a payout.
